attacks.name: Gather Energy
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Seek Out
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Triple Smash
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.effect: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon (remove 1 damage counter if that Pokémon has only 1).
Search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
